data.import_history: Import history when first set up
data.schedule_mode: When to sync with the portal

data_description.update_interval_hours: Used in fixed-interval mode, and when following the gauge until its upload interval is known.
data_description.backfill_states: Write the hourly readings the gauge uploads in batches into Home Assistant's state history at their real times, so the built-in history graphs show every hour. Long-term statistics are always updated.
data_description.import_history: On first setup, download the gauge's full hourly history from the portal and add it to Home Assistant. You can run it again at any time with the Import history button.
data_description.schedule_mode: Follow the gauge's upload schedule: sync a few minutes after each expected upload, using the upload interval set on the portal, with retries if an upload is late. Fixed interval: sync every N hours.

effective_interval_hours.name: Interval in use by the gauge

api_breakage.description: Home Assistant cannot parse data from the Smart Oil Gauge portal. The vendor web portal structure may have changed. Check for integration updates.
